name: MNCS Atlas
description: Non-normative, machine-readable orientation map for the Machine-Native Complexity Standard project family and its current operator stack.

freshness.policy: Atlas is descriptive orientation. Verify implementation-sensitive claims against the owning repository before acting.

invariants: Missing or insufficient evidence remains UNKNOWN.

projects.name: MNCS / MNCDS
projects.responsibility: Technical authority, evidence and status semantics, development governance, schemas, RFCs, and claim boundaries.

projects.name: MNCS Language
projects.responsibility: Verification-native language and semantic representation research, including contracts, effects, evidence, HIR, and SSA.

projects.name: Forge
projects.responsibility: Non-normative bounded development and evidence workflows, provider orchestration, lineage, evidence gaps, and evaluator-mode boundaries.

projects.name: Fabric
projects.responsibility: Persistent exact-target execution, authenticated transport, worker presence, capability and resource observations, retries, and execution evidence.

projects.name: Commons
projects.responsibility: Structured provenance-aware knowledge exchange and durable work coordination for observations, claims, requests, replications, advisories, and decisions.

projects.name: RAVEL
projects.responsibility: Evidence strategy, scoped memory, causal interpretation, and reusable learning beneath MNCS and MNCDS authority.

projects.name: MNEL
projects.responsibility: Investigators, bounded interventions, causal attribution, negative memory, and verified-experience distillation.

projects.name: Reference Studies
projects.responsibility: Controlled empirical comparisons, case studies, reimplementations, reproducibility, and first-class negative results.

projects.name: Rust Validator
projects.responsibility: Independent offline validation for supported MNCS subsets without wrapping the Python implementation or executing evidence.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.responsibility: Family map, shared terminology, project boundaries, contributor pathways, operator-model documentation, and machine-readable orientation.

operator_components.name: MNCS Control MCP
operator_components.responsibility: Exposes an authorized development workspace, Git, process, project, tooling, and bounded MNCS adapters through a fail-closed sandboxed control surface.

operator_components.name: Local Harness
operator_components.responsibility: Owns workspace meaning, model and tool routing, approvals, local agent loops, deployment-level result acceptance, and escalation while consuming persistent Fabric and Commons services.

relationships.description: Control may expose Local Harness capabilities while preserving Harness routing, policy, and acceptance ownership.
Control consumes the persistent Fabric service and does not own the worker registry, trust material, or fleet lifecycle.
Control consumes bounded Commons interfaces and does not own the Commons store or service lifecycle.
Harness chooses or pins model/tool work; Fabric owns exact-target admission, transport, execution, and execution evidence.
Harness mediates bounded Commons tools for local and Fabric-backed models while retaining tool policy.
Forge may delegate bounded execution to Fabric while preserving evidence-workflow lineage and evaluator boundaries.
Forge does not self-promote results; governing validation remains with the authority declared by MNCS or MNCDS.
RAVEL may learn from governed Commons records without turning publication into truth.
MNEL may use scoped records and outcomes as experimental inputs while preserving their evidence status.
Reference Studies test bounded claims under frozen protocols; study outcomes do not silently rewrite the standard.

entry_points.goal: Understand acceptance, evidence semantics, or conformance
entry_points.note: Read the governing standard before tool-specific documentation.

entry_points.goal: Develop or evaluate a candidate with declared evidence workflows
entry_points.note: Forge is non-normative; validators retain the authority assigned to them.

entry_points.goal: Route local model and guarded tool work
entry_points.note: This is deployment policy, not MNCS conformance.
Control is a protected workspace surface and service consumer.

entry_points.goal: Run a bounded workload on an exact worker
entry_points.note: Execution evidence does not itself establish conformance.

entry_points.goal: Share durable findings, work, replications, or decisions
Learn from governed outcomes or run bounded experiments
Challenge claims empirically or validate supported records independently
entry_points.note: Keep study-local and validator-local authority explicit.
